label: late-original-phase a in sequences starting with l/k (weak)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.035% of steps). It fires only in the last few original-phase steps (t=5-8, mostly to_go<=2) and sometimes on <DEL>, never in the copy phase. It is strongly enriched when the first original token is l (18x lift, 67% of mass) or k (4x), when the current input is a (14x, 51% of mass), and when o or g appeared 1-2 steps earlier. The largest activations are a near the end of l-initial sequences, e.g. l k z o o o [a]. No simple conjunction separates it well: first_tok==l & t>=5 has recall 0.55 but precision 0.04, and the best compact predicate (input a at t>=5 in an l/k-initial sequence) reaches only F1 ~0.25 and mass recall ~0.34 on dev. Many activations are small and spread across other tokens in l-initial sequences. It looks like a conjunction of hidden-state directions (first token l/k, recent o/g, current a) that the available variables do not capture.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=l (+6.93), orig0=k (+4.53), orig1=l (+3.60), orig1=k (+3.53), orig1=r (+3.51), orig2=g (+3.46). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-5.41), phase=2 (-4.44), t=3 (-4.34), t=4 (-3.91).
